ai.disclaimer: AI-writing scores are statistical estimates, not proof. Detectors make mistakes, are known to flag non-native English writers more often, and can be wrong on short, formulaic or heavily edited text. Never use this score alone to make an academic-misconduct decision; review the evidence with the student.

sentences.text: Lecturers should give students clear guidance about using artificial intelligence tools in coursework.
Many universities in Southern Africa are still drafting such policies.
Artificial intelligence has transformed many aspects of modern education.
It offers personalized learning experiences, streamlines administrative tasks, and provides valuable insights into student performance.
However, it also raises important ethical considerations that institutions must address thoughtfully.
